#the range function gives each one a number, and the 
#loop plays them in order. 
#easier to read than playnote over and over

    [60, 64, 67],  # C major
    [60, 64, 67],  # C major
    [62, 65, 69],  # D minor
    [62, 65, 69],  # D minor
    [64, 67, 71],  # E minor
    [65, 69, 72],  # F major
    [64, 67, 71],  # E minor
    [62, 65, 69]   # D minor
]

for i in range(len(chords)):
    playNote(chords[i], beats=4)
